2607.28680.title: TELLER: Dual-Path Iterative Preference Optimization for Table Entity Linking
2607.28680.paper_summary: Entity linking in tables matches short and ambiguous cell mentions to their corresponding knowledge-base entities. Existing approaches typically rely on data preprocessing pipelines that retain either compact or extensive table content as contextual evidence, and then formulate entity linking as a language generation task for instruction-tuned models; recent systems further incorporate explicit reasoning to disambiguate challenging mentions. However, their training supervision is usually static: fixed preference data cannot adapt to the residual errors of an evolving model, while variations in reasoning length can bias sequence-level preference learning. To address these limitations, we present TELLER: Table Entity Linking through Learning from Errors and Reasoning. We first retrieve and rank Wikidata candidates and retain reduced table evidence in the prompt. The direct-answer path applies iterative direct preference optimization and refreshes its preference data with residual errors from the updated model. The reasoning path uses filtered and compressed chain-of-thought rationales for supervised fine-tuning, followed by our iterative length-normalized regularized preference optimization. On the TableInstruct entity-linking subset, the direct-answer path improves accuracy from 94.35\% to 94.50\%; on the MammoTab V2 evaluation set, it improves accuracy from 87.59\% to 88.20\%. The reasoning path improves accuracy from 92.90\% to 92.95\% on TableInstruct and from 79.09\% to 81.85\% on MammoTab V2, while maintaining high rates of complete reasoning generation. These results show that iterative preference learning benefits both concise entity prediction and explicit reasoning.
2607.28680.paper_summary_zh: 實體連結在表格中將簡短且模糊的單元格提及與其對應的知識庫實體匹配。現有的方法通常依賴數據預處理管道，保留緊湊或廣泛的表格內容作為上下文證據，然後將實體連結表述為指令調整模型的語言生成任務；最近的系統進一步納入明確的推理以消除挑戰性提及的歧義。然而，他們的訓練監督通常是靜態的：固定的偏好數據無法適應不斷演變模型的殘餘錯誤，而推理長度的變化可能會使序列級別的偏好學習產生偏差。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了 TELLER：通過從錯誤和推理中學習的表格實體連結。我們首先檢索和排名 Wikidata 候選者，並在提示中保留減少的表格證據。直接答案路徑應用迭代的直接偏好優化，並用更新模型的殘餘錯誤刷新其偏好數據。推理路徑使用過濾和壓縮的思維鏈理據進行監督性微調，然後是我們的迭代長度正規化的偏好優化。在 TableInstruct 實體連結子集上，直接答案路徑的準確率從 94.35\% 提高到 94.50\%；在 MammoTab V2 評估集上，準確率從 87.59\% 提高到 88.20\%。推理路徑的準確率在 TableInstruct 上從 92.90\% 提高到 92.95\%，在 MammoTab V2 上從 79.09\% 提高到 81.85\%，同時保持高比例的完整推理生成。這些結果顯示，迭代偏好學習有利於簡潔的實體預測和明確的推理。
